summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the 'Modify & Issue' flow on the NewInvoice page. All 11 requested behaviours pass: navigation with ?from={id}, breadcrumb 'Modify & Issue', all 8 A-H section headers with LHDN Red bars, prefills for Section A (Invoice/MYR/1/date), Section B supplier TIN/Name/MSIC, MSIC search working (typing 'dental' returns 5 items including 86203 Dental services), Section C buyer picker with reactive read-only fields updating on pick, Section D line prefill (MSIC Test Item, qty 1, price 100, MSIC 86201 General medical services), line MSIC editable via combobox (changed to 86203), qty/price live-recalc (3 * 50 = 150.00), Section G shipping/charges flow to Section H Total Payable live (150 + 9 tax + 20 shipping + 5 charges = 184.00), 'Add line' inserts a new row with data-testid=line-msic-1, Save as draft POSTs to /api/invoices and navigates to the new /invoices/{id} with InvoiceDetail Section D Classification correctly rendering '(86203) Dental services' (per-line MSIC persisted end-to-end), Close/X button returns to the source detail page, and regression /invoices/new (without ?from) renders with breadcrumb 'New Invoice', blank line description, default MSIC (86201) General medical services, and default buyer (Wellness Family Clinic).
critical_code_review_comments: NewInvoice.jsx is ~680 lines and does five concerns in one file (state, prefill effects, totals, save, presentational sub-components). Consider splitting into hooks (useInvoiceForm, useLineTotals) and a components/newInvoice/ folder for maintainability, but not blocking.

Section F 'Tax Rate' currently displays only the FIRST line's tax_rate, which is misleading if lines have mixed tax rates. Consider aggregating by tax_rate group or clearly labelling as 'primary rate'.

Section D 'Product' picker still overwrites a manually chosen line MSIC when a product is selected afterwards (carried over from iteration 11). Consider only overwriting msic if it currently equals the default 86201 OR if the user hasn't manually chosen one this session.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 new draft invoice via the Modify & Issue flow proving line MSIC (86203 Dental services) persistence. Also created 1 blank draft via regression /invoices/new flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 'Modify & Issue' end-to-end flow (source invoice 6a75616467265bc869f840b9 with line MSIC 86201) is verified working. Prefills, MSIC combobox search, live totals, buyer switch, Add/Remove line, Save-as-draft persistence, and back navigation all pass. Regression /invoices/new (no ?from) also renders correctly with defaults. Only the pre-existing UX quirk (product picker clobbering manually-chosen line MSIC) remains as a design decision for the main agent.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions found in this iteration.
